notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible
easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 40 or less life.
description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 40 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to The Rollercrusher Ride.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent loses the game.
